17 latent reading collisions (attested readings offered by other cards) are not drawable in the checked N1, All and Starter pools.

Two KANJIDIC2 name-only readings can be drawn as wrong options and are disclosed, not fixed: 炊 い on the スイ prompt in the N1 and All stacks, and 納 ろ on the ナッ prompt in a Starter session that also borrows 路.

reading-options.txt labels 端 はじめ (offered by 初) and 致 おこす (offered by 起) as hits because that older check ignores filled slots; the 端 はし and 致 いた.す prompts are filled by three curated distractors in the N1, All and Starter pools, so the fallback is never consulted (reading-exposure.txt), and the older check's 100-seed simulation drew neither reading.
8 lint warnings on existing word articles' Dictionary lines are pre-existing and out of scope.
納's only quizzed on reading is ナッ (納得), beside the kun reading おさ.める: the common on reading ノウ has no word article yet; ナッ is a separate reading in the Joyo table.
駄 quizzes only タ (下駄), a KANJIDIC2 and Daijisen reading that the Joyo table omits; ダ rests only on 無駄, an ateji spelling, and is not quizzed.
Source-only readings (異 け; 透 とう.る, とう.す) are listed but have no ordinary example and are not quizzed.
Each mnemonic is a modern-shape memory aid, labelled on the card as not etymology.
The reading audits are the author's Python ports of the Kotlin builder; no Kotlin cross-check was run.

Claude's initial review once had two view calls in flight; GPT's shell and Python reads are not counted in its audit's packet coverage, its live web fetches were made through Python urllib, and three confirmation reads used the parent review-packets folder as a base path for the two allowed packets. GPT's confirmation report names its model only as GPT (OpenAI); the model name comes from the runtime records. Claude's confirmation report places a live 致す re-read in that round; the session events show it in Claude's initial run.
Both confirmations checked においうま in JMdict only through the packet's 駄 family extracts and live jisho.org queries; the author's search of the full pinned JMdict found no entry with that reading.
The confirmation packets' unittest excerpt lost its final OK line to a PowerShell stderr wrapper (flagged by GPT); the full gate log and a clean rerun at the fix commit both show 436 tests OK.
